action.description: Use status to read mission state. Use set-local or set-go-to with coordinate triples. Use set-takeoff, set-land, or set-return-to-launch for mission items matching the controller-supported MAVROS waypoint commands.

tensorfleet-project-path.description: Optional Tensorfleet project directory path for legacy .tensorfleet/.env fallback.

points.description: Mission sequence as semicolon-separated items. Bare coordinate items use x,y,z and default to go-to. Type-prefixed items are also supported: go-to:x,y,z, takeoff:x,y,z, land:x,y,z, return-to-launch.
